summary: Candidate 'Custom Source Function Integration' is a distinct session_skill for pluggable enterprise source connectors (Kafka, databases, proprietary systems) using addSource() API. It differs semantically from peer candidates (file-based, collection-based, socket-based sources) which target specific built-in source types. Existing skills are unrelated (Next.js metadata, executor concurrency). No merge, split, or revision applies. Support evidence is minimal but not conflicting. Candidate should be created as a new capability.
